resources.string: Nail plate advance in the drawing
Length added at the matrix per step (a)
Plate mark from the matrix: %1$s u

Advance = n × a, where n counts drawing steps and a is the length added in one step. Mark position = 4 u + advance. The nail bed ends at 10 u on this drawing; beyond that line the mark is on the free edge.

The nail matrix at the root forms most of the plate. As new plate material joins at the root, a mark on the older plate moves with it toward the fingertip, over the nail bed and then onto the free edge. The drawing places the matrix at 0 u and the mark initially at 4 u. These lengths are invented drawing units (u), and steps are not days. This is not a growth measurement or prediction.
